lessons.title: Shared material is not sufficient proof
lessons.text: B-1043 shares fabric and thread with B-1042 but has a low defect rate on a different machine. Treat as precautionary monitoring.

lessons.title: Complaint signal predates final failure
lessons.text: B-1038 complaints describe side seam opening after use. Link the customer language to the same location and verify returned garments.

scenario.title: Multi-factory quality operations
scenario.description: Synthetic demonstration: 4 factories, 54 batches, changing seam performance, material controls and customer signals. All records are illustrative.
scenario.focus: Contain current seam exceptions and verify recovery capacity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tension drift after setup is associated with seam failures.
hypotheses.test: Compare MG-7 with MG-3 using the same fabric and stage; inspect setup logs.

whys: The side seam opens under light pull.
Stitch formation is inconsistent after setup.
Machine tension drift is suspected; testing is still required.
